summary.title: El Niño weather pattern impacts global solar irradiance levels
summary.main_point: The 2026 El Niño weather pattern has caused significant variations in global solar irradiance, with some regions seeing deviations from long-term averages of over 30%.
bullets: Research from Solargis indicates that global horizontal irradiance levels departed from long-term seasonal averages by over 30% in some locations.
The June-July-August season variations are attributed to El Niño and higher-than-normal temperatures.

summary.title: Spain awards €265 million for pumped hydro storage projects
summary.main_point: Spain has awarded €265 million to 11 pumped hydro energy storage projects totaling 4.1 GW and 49.9 GWh of capacity.
bullets: The funding is part of the Boralmac program, with projects expected to be completed by 2035.
The first round in July 2024 awarded €100 million to four projects totaling nearly 2 GW of turbine capacity and 28.85 GWh of storage.
The BOREAL project in Alcántara received the largest award of €44.9 million.

summary.title: Energiequelle sells French subsidiary to H2air
summary.main_point: German renewables developer Energiequelle has sold its French subsidiary, which includes a 500MW solar PV and wind pipeline, to H2air.
bullets: The sale includes a 500MW solar PV and wind pipeline.

summary.title: REMCL tenders rooftop solar for Mumbai railway stations
summary.main_point: Railway Energy Management Company has invited bids for grid-connected rooftop solar projects at four Central Railway stations in Mumbai.
bullets: The tender is issued on behalf of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation.

summary.title: India reports solar manufacturing capacity growth in first half of 2026
summary.main_point: India added 50.6 GW of solar module and 9.7 GW of cell manufacturing capacity in the first half of 2026.
bullets: Cumulative capacity reached 261.7 GW for modules and 36.6 GW for cells as of June 2026.
Capacity under the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers stood at 225.5 GW for modules and nearly 35.5 GW for cells.
Domestic cell shortages are identified as the biggest near-term challenge for the market.

summary.title: China module prices remain steady ahead of Golden Week
summary.main_point: Mainstream TOPCon module prices in China remained unchanged at $0.108/W FOB China as market liquidity stayed thin.
bullets: The Chinese Module Marker benchmark for TOPCon modules below 645W remained at $0.108/W.
Market participants are showing reluctance to commit to transactions due to uncertainty regarding year-end price directions.

summary.title: US solar module prices rise following Section 232 measures
summary.main_point: Median prices for imported solar modules in the U.S. have increased by over 40% following the introduction of Section 232 price floors and tariffs.
bullets: Anza reports that the median price for imported modules was $0.27 (pv magazine USA).
A 15% additional tariff on certain polysilicon products and minimum import prices for wafers, cells, and modules were announced on August 6, 2026 (Mercom India).
The 15% tariff on polysilicon products takes effect on December 4 (pv magazine USA).

summary.title: Floating solar array installed on Ohio village reservoir
summary.main_point: Floating solar developer D3Energy has energized a 6 MW floating photovoltaic (FPV) array in the Village of Monroeville, Ohio.

summary.title: B2U and LGES partner on battery repurposing for grid storage
summary.main_point: B2U Storage Solutions and LG Energy Solution are partnering to repurpose EV batteries for grid-scale energy storage applications.
bullets: The partnership aims to use B2U's technology to extend the life of LG Energy Solution EV batteries before recycling.
NYSERDA has selected 950MW of bids for its first large-scale energy storage resource solicitation (Energy-Storage.news).

summary.title: Websol secures land for 4GW solar manufacturing plant in West Bengal
summary.main_point: Websol Energy System has acquired land to build a 4GW solar cell and module manufacturing facility in West Bengal, India.
bullets: India added 50.6 GW of solar module and 9.7 GW of cell manufacturing capacity in the first half of 2026.
Cumulative solar manufacturing capacity in India reached 261.7 GW for modules and 36.6 GW for cells as of June 2026.
As of the report's release, 225.5 GW of module capacity and nearly 35.5 GW of cell capacity were under the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers.
Domestic cell shortages are identified as a significant challenge, causing production struggles for module manufacturers.

summary.title: Solar irradiance patterns across India during the 2026 monsoon season
summary.main_point: Solar irradiance in northwestern and southern India was above average during the 2026 summer monsoon, while eastern and central regions experienced reductions due to August storms.
bullets: Irradiance in sunnier regions was approximately 5% above the long-term average for the early June to September period.
August irradiance levels in these areas reached up to 10% above the long-term average.
The majority of India's utility-scale PV capacity is located in regions that experienced favourable irradiance conditions.
Weaker monsoon effects are consistent with a strong El Niño that developed throughout 2027.

summary.title: Tegrona releases free software for rooftop solar layout planning
summary.main_point: Tegrona has launched Tegrona Lite, a free tool that allows installers to plan photovoltaic system layouts using photographs of roofs.
bullets: The software enables users to estimate module capacity without CAD tools or on-site measurements.
It supports drone photos, ground-level images, and roof plans, featuring perspective correction for distorted ground-level photographs.

summary.title: EWS reports 14% higher winter wheat yield at Austrian agrivoltaic site
summary.main_point: Austrian agrivoltaics specialist EWS observed a 14% increase in winter wheat yield at its Sonnenfeld research site compared to a control area.
bullets: The result was recorded during the dry summer of 2026 in 12-meter-wide cultivation strips.
The company attributes the yield increase to partial shading and microclimate changes provided by tracking PV arrays.

summary.title: Germany, Austria and Luxembourg launch €2.12 billion eSAF program
summary.main_point: The three countries have launched a dual-auction mechanism to support the production and adoption of renewable electricity-based sustainable aviation fuel.
bullets: Germany will contribute up to €2 billion, while Austria and Luxembourg will each provide up to €60 million.
The program uses a double-auction model where public subsidies cover the price gap between eSAF producers and buyers.

summary.title: MSEDCL invites bids for battery energy storage systems
summary.main_point: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company has initiated a tender process to procure energy from battery energy storage systems.
bullets: ESR has signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Aquila Clean Energy APAC (Energy-Storage.news).

summary.title: GESCOM invites rooftop solar bids; Cleantech Solar commissions 36 MWp project
summary.main_point: GESCOM has issued a tender for rooftop solar on government buildings, while Cleantech Solar has commissioned 36 MWp of open-access solar capacity in Tamil Nadu.
bullets: The GESCOM project includes five years of operation and maintenance (Mercom India).
Cleantech Solar's 36 MWp project is located at its 200 MWp renewable energy park in Thoothukudi district (pv magazine India).

summary.title: Zhejiang province opens electricity spot market to grid-side batteries
summary.main_point: Regulators in China's Zhejiang province have issued a notice allowing independent grid-side storage projects to participate in the provincial electricity spot market.
bullets: Storage projects can choose daily whether to enter the energy market or the frequency-regulation ancillary services market.
A transition to price-and-quantity bidding for these projects is planned for 2027.

summary.title: U.S. solar module prices rise following Section 232 tariff implementation
summary.main_point: Solar module prices have increased following the introduction of a 15% tariff on polysilicon products and new import price floors.
bullets: Anza reports that median prices for imported solar modules have jumped by more than 40% (Mercom India).
Anza expects at least a 40% spike in U.S. solar module prices following the December 4 effective date for the 15% Section 232 tariff (pv magazine).

summary.title: Power Electronics begins construction of 40 GW manufacturing campus in Houston
summary.main_point: Power Electronics has broken ground on a new manufacturing campus in Houston, Texas, to produce inverters for solar, storage, and data center markets.
bullets: The new facility is located on more than 53 acres of land.

summary.title: Best of the Week: IRENA’s latest report, US module prices climb and Abu Dhabi raises solar ambitions
summary.main_point: Welcome to the PV Tech Best of the Week roundup, covering the week's biggest stories from the global solar industry.

summary.title: Low Carbon plans to build 500MW UK solar-plus-storage project
summary.main_point: UK renewables developer Low Carbon has announced plans for a 500MW solar PV project in Oxfordshire.
bullets: The project is located in the county of Oxfordshire.

summary.title: Italy raises Macse energy storage auction premium cap
summary.main_point: Italy's energy regulator Arera has increased the maximum premium cap for the upcoming Macse energy storage auction to €27,000 per MWh.
bullets: The cap was raised from €22,000 to €27,000 per MWh under resolution 332/2026.
The auction applies to a 2029 delivery year and provides a 15-year fixed premium.

summary.title: Longi sets 28.29% world record for single-junction silicon solar cell efficiency
summary.main_point: Longi has achieved a new world record of 28.29% efficiency for a hybrid interdigitated-back-contact silicon solar cell.
bullets: The result was verified by Germany’s Institute for Solar Energy Research Hamelin.
This surpasses the company's previous record of 28.13% achieved in May.

summary.title: India expected to commission 45-50 GWh of BESS capacity by fiscal 2028
summary.main_point: Crisil Ratings projects that India will commission 45-50 GWh of battery energy storage system capacity across fiscals 2027 and 2028.
bullets: Around 8-9 GWh of awarded capacity faces delay risks due to weak returns and limited developer experience.
SECI has separately listed 7.67 GW of renewable energy and storage capacity for sale (Mercom India).

summary.title: CERC allows project more time for 38 MW infirm solar power injection
summary.main_point: The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission granted a solar generator 45 additional days to inject infirm power for a 38.1 MW portion of its project.
bullets: The extension applies to the balance 38.1 MW capacity of a 250 MW solar project located in Barmer, Rajasthan.

summary.title: SECI invites proposals to prepare DPRs for green hydrogen hubs
summary.main_point: The Solar Energy Corporation of India is seeking agencies to prepare detailed project reports for green hydrogen hubs.
bullets: The initiative falls under Component B1 of the National Green Hydrogen Mission.

summary.title: U.S. government restricts pre-tariff solar stockpiling ahead of December 4 deadline
summary.main_point: The U.S. Department of Commerce has implemented emergency rules to limit solar supply chain imports before new tariffs take effect.
bullets: The rule imposes monitoring and volume caps on polysilicon, wafers, cells, and modules.
A 15% tariff and minimum import prices will apply to shipments starting December 4.

summary.title: Why solar contractors should reconsider multi-tenant commercial projects
summary.main_point: Solar contractors are encouraged to reconsider multi-tenant commercial projects despite their reputation for complexity.
bullets: Installers often avoid multi-tenant properties due to time-consuming pipelines and project management challenges.

summary.title: Twenty-two U.S. solar PV manufacturers included in first domestic ratings pyramid
summary.main_point: Terawatt PV Research has released a ratings pyramid ranking 22 U.S. solar manufacturers based on production volume and capital expenditure.
bullets: First Solar is the only company to receive a AAA rating.
Six companies in total are rated A or above.

summary.title: Germany wraps up solar-plus-storage tender with average price of €0.0514/kWh
summary.main_point: Germany concluded a tender for innovative renewable energy projects, awarding 480 MW of solar-plus-storage capacity at an average price of €0.0514/kWh.
bullets: The tender attracted 53 bids for a total of 678 MW, with 32 projects selected.
Awarded tariffs ranged from €0.0450/kWh to €0.0540/kWh.
Bavaria secured the most capacity at 177 MW, followed by Brandenburg with 94 MW and North Rhine-Westphalia with 48 MW.
A previous tender in June awarded 482 MW across 29 projects with an average price of €0.0534/kWh.

summary.title: SMA battery inverter first to win grid-forming certification for German inertia market
summary.main_point: SMA Solar Technology has received the first certification for a battery inverter capable of providing inertia to the German grid.
bullets: The certification confirms the inverter's capability to support grid stability through inertia.

summary.title: Neoen starts construction on 122MW solar PV portfolio in France
summary.main_point: French independent power producer Neoen has begun construction on a 122MW solar PV portfolio in France, which includes agriPV and floating PV projects.
bullets: The portfolio consists of 122MW of solar capacity.

summary.title: Bilayer transparent conductive film for electrostatic dust removal achieves 96.36% cleaning rate
summary.main_point: Researchers in China developed a bilayer film using carbon nanotubes and magnesium fluoride that achieves a 96.36% dust removal rate on solar panels.
bullets: The film combines single-walled carbon nanotubes for conductivity with a magnesium fluoride layer to smooth the surface and improve dust removal.
The study examined the impact of magnesium fluoride layer thickness on the optical and electrical properties of the films.

summary.title: Heterojunction solar cell based on molybdenum oxide achieves 24.9% efficiency
summary.main_point: Researchers from Beijing University of Technology developed a silicon heterojunction solar cell with 24.9% efficiency using a molybdenum oxide hole transport layer.
bullets: The cell incorporates an approximately 1-nm-thick phosphomolybdic acid interlayer to improve stability and efficiency.
The design aims to reduce reliance on conventional p-type doped silicon hole-selective contacts.

summary.title: China and U.S. module prices hold ahead of Golden Week
summary.main_point: Mainstream TOPCon module prices in China remained stable at $0.108/W as market activity slowed ahead of the Golden Week holiday.
bullets: Market participants are hesitant to commit to transactions due to uncertainty regarding future price directions.
Weak domestic installation demand has continued to exert pressure on module prices.

summary.title: Anti-stockpiling rules critical ahead of Section 232 tariffs
summary.main_point: The US solar industry is addressing new limits on polysilicon imports in anticipation of upcoming Section 232 rules.
bullets: Industry stakeholders view the anti-stockpiling measures as critical ahead of the implementation of new tariffs.

summary.title: Decommissioning to drive 23% of solar buildout in the 2040s
summary.main_point: Wood Mackenzie forecasts that repowering decommissioned solar and wind projects will account for a significant portion of future installations as global assets reach their end of life.
bullets: More than 2.5 TW of solar and wind projects are expected to reach the end of their design life by 2040.
Solar is expected to have a larger ageing fleet than wind by 2040.

summary.title: Renewable Properties acquires 71.8 MW Pennsylvania solar portfolio from Prospect14
summary.main_point: Renewable Properties acquired three solar projects totaling 71.8 MWdc in Pennsylvania from developer Prospect14.
bullets: The portfolio includes a 26 MWdc project, a 27 MWdc project, and an 18.8 MWdc project.
This acquisition marks the company's entry into the PJM wholesale market.
The companies previously completed a deal in August 2025 for 38.13 MWdc of net metered projects.

summary.title: Rezolv Energy secures financing for 1.3 GWp solar project in Romania
summary.main_point: Rezolv Energy has secured up to €561 million in financing for the 1.3 GWp Dama Solar project in Romania.
bullets: The financing package is valued at €561 million (PV Tech) or up to €561 million ($637.3 million) (pv magazine).
The project is expected to generate approximately 1.8 TWh of electricity annually.
The facility will be located in Arad county and is intended to cover the consumption of over 280,000 households.

summary.title: Over Easy Solar releases 256 W vertical rooftop PV unit
summary.main_point: Over Easy Solar has launched the xM-3 Quattor-256S, a 256 W bifacial vertical PV unit for flat rooftops.
bullets: The company received an Environmental Product Declaration for its xM-3 flat-roof system, covering both panels and mounting structure.
The system's A1-A3 footprint is 51.5 kg CO₂e/m².
The global warming footprint for energy generation is 19 g CO₂e/kWh, based on a yield of 1,000 kWh/kW.

summary.title: Belgium reports results of 2024 PV cable inspection campaign
summary.main_point: Belgium's Federal Public Service Economy tested PV cables from 10 manufacturers to verify performance compliance.
bullets: The campaign aimed to verify compliance with Regulation (EU) No. 305/2011 and prevent unfair competition.
Testing was conducted by the Scientific Institute of Public Service using laboratory analysis of collected samples.
The assessment included cables with a cross-section of 4 mm².

summary.title: Global solar capacity additions reached 690 GW in 2025
summary.main_point: Global solar installations grew by 15% in 2025 to reach 690 GW, according to IEA-PVPS.
bullets: Cumulative global solar capacity reached 2.96 TW by the end of 2025.
China led global installations with 415 GW, followed by India (54 GW), the United States (43 GW), Germany (18 GW), and Pakistan (14 GW).
India's industrial sector accounted for the second-highest share of its 3.8 GW rooftop solar additions in the second quarter of 2026 (Mercom India).

summary.title: Fox ESS launches modular C&I battery storage system
summary.main_point: Fox ESS has introduced the Power Beast modular storage system, which can scale up to 96 MWh.
bullets: The system is scalable from 28 kWh to nearly 1,000 kWh on a single inverter.
Maximum on-grid configuration allows for 96 MWh, while off-grid is limited to 28.8 MWh.
The system utilizes 125 kW H3 Plus hybrid inverters and CQ series high-voltage batteries.

summary.title: TrueRE Oriana Power sells 110 MWp solar portfolio to Actis
summary.main_point: TrueRE Oriana Power has sold a 110 MWp C&I solar portfolio to Actis for an enterprise value of INR 501 crore.
bullets: The sale is part of a larger proposed divestment of 238 MW of operational solar assets.
The company transferred its stake in Truere Guj SPV Pvt Ltd and Truere Current Pvt Ltd.

summary.title: Heliene launches new rooftop solar module
summary.main_point: Heliene has introduced an all-black solar module for the US rooftop market and secured a supply agreement with Sunrun.
bullets: The new module is designed specifically for the rooftop solar sector.
The company has entered into a supply agreement with Sunrun.

summary.title: Exus acquires 715 MWp solar portfolio in the US
summary.main_point: Exus Renewables North America has purchased a four-project solar portfolio totaling 715 MWp from ibV Energy Partners.
bullets: The acquisition consists of four separate solar projects.

summary.title: 150 MW Three W Solar project completed in Texas
summary.main_point: Black & Veatch has completed the 150 MW Three W Solar project in Hillsboro, Texas, for Mitsui & Co.
bullets: The project has achieved substantial completion.
The facility has received approval from ERCOT.

summary.title: X-Elio starts commercial operations at 368MW Spanish solar PV project
summary.main_point: X-Elio has commenced commercial operations at its 368MW Lorca Solar project in Spain.
bullets: The Lorca Solar project is X-Elio's largest solar PV project in Spain.

summary.title: Spanish researchers validate 10,000 cycles for iron-lead flow battery
summary.main_point: CIC energiGUNE has successfully tested an iron-lead redox flow battery for 10,000 charge-discharge cycles.
bullets: The battery design uses abundant materials and a fluorine-free membrane to reduce internal resistance.
The technology is intended for stationary applications requiring several hours of storage.

summary.title: Ireland energizes first SRESS solar farm
summary.main_point: The 650 kW Meadhill Solar farm in County Cork is the first project energized under Ireland's Small-Scale Renewable Energy Support Scheme.
bullets: The project generates enough energy to power approximately 150 homes.
The developer has signed a 15-year power purchase agreement with Flogas.

summary.title: South Korea grid overhaul to connect more than 100 GW of renewables
summary.main_point: South Korea's Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment is lifting renewable energy connection restrictions in the Honam and Chungcheong regions.
bullets: Restrictions on the east coast are scheduled to be lifted in the first half of 2027.
A new flexible connection regime will allow projects to connect beyond normal hosting limits, subject to curtailment.

summary.title: Assam DISCOM invites bids to install solar projects and solar trees
summary.main_point: The Assam Power Distribution Company has issued a tender for 950 kW of solar projects and five 10 kW solar trees.
bullets: The installation is planned for Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev Avirbhav Kshetra in the Nagaon district.

summary.title: ACME Solar commissions additional 107.36 MW/437.49 MWh of BESS capacity
summary.main_point: ACME Solar has added 107.36 MW/437.49 MWh of battery energy storage capacity in Rajasthan, bringing its total operational capacity to 4.96 GWh.
bullets: The new capacity includes a 53.73 MW/222.969 MWh project and a 53.63 MW/214.52 MWh project.
The firm and dispatchable renewable energy project has a 25-year power purchase agreement.

summary.title: Heliene launches new solar rooftop module
summary.main_point: Heliene has introduced an all-black solar module for the US rooftop market and secured a supply agreement with Sunrun.
bullets: The module is designed specifically for residential rooftop applications.

summary.title: Overview Energy to develop homing beacon for space-based solar transmission
summary.main_point: Overview Energy has received a Department of War contract to develop a homing beacon for space-based solar energy systems.
bullets: The beacons are designed to authenticate connections between satellites and ground receiving sites to prevent signal spoofing.

summary.title: California governor signs bills approving virtual power plants
summary.main_point: Governor Gavin Newsom signed SB 913 and SB 905, authorizing the implementation of virtual power plants across California.
bullets: The legislation aims to reduce electricity bills by utilizing home and business energy equipment.

summary.title: German startup wins grant for grid-charging sodium-ion home battery
summary.main_point: Revolta AG has received funding from the German state of Hesse to develop a sodium-ion AC battery for residential use.
bullets: The project has eligible costs of €660,545 with a 40% EU co-financing rate.
The system is designed to charge when grid prices are low and discharge when prices are high.
The project is scheduled to run from Aug. 1, 2026, to Dec. 31, 2029.

summary.title: Spain’s first pre-commercial marine solar demonstrator enters testing
summary.main_point: A 1 MW floating solar installation developed by BlueNewables and Naturgy has begun testing at the Port of Valencia.
bullets: The installation consists of two 500 kW PV-bos platforms.
Testing will evaluate performance, maintenance requirements, and integration into port infrastructure.

summary.title: Germany sitting on 600,000 tonnes of solar PV waste by 2030
summary.main_point: Germany is projected to generate over 600,000 tonnes of solar PV waste by 2030.
bullets: The waste material is estimated to be potentially worth billions in aluminium and silver.

summary.title: Developments in Indian battery energy storage capacity
summary.main_point: The Solar Energy Corporation of India has invited bids for standalone battery storage projects, while Adani Green Energy has expanded its operational capacity.
bullets: Adani Green Energy Ltd has increased its operational BESS capacity to 6.63 GWh at Khavda, Gujarat (pv magazine India).
Adani Green Energy Ltd claims to account for over 50% of India's total operational BESS capacity of about 12.6 GWh (pv magazine India).
The Solar Energy Corporation of India has floated a tender for standalone battery energy storage systems for on-demand use (Mercom India).

summary.title: Japan tightens grid access as battery queue reaches 172 GW
summary.main_point: Japan's grid operator has introduced new measures to prevent capacity hoarding in a battery storage queue that has reached 172 GW.
bullets: Projects receiving grid connection approval from Oct. 1 must prove site usage rights within two months to maintain their reservation.
Less than 1 GW of grid-scale storage is currently connected in Japan.

summary.title: Milky Mist Banks on 25 MW Solar Project for Energy Self-Sufficiency
summary.main_point: Contributing nearly a quarter of the world’s milk supply, India’s dairy industry employs more than 80 million farmers.

summary.title: California governor signs balcony solar and VPP legislation
summary.main_point: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed legislation legalizing balcony solar systems in the state.
bullets: SB 868, the Plug and Play Solar Act, was signed to eliminate red tape for balcony solar systems.
California is the 10th state to legalize balcony solar.

summary.title: India approves US$19.3 billion Green Energy Corridor Phase III with 50GWh BESS
summary.main_point: India's Union Cabinet has approved US$ 19.3 billion Green Energy Corridor, including US$ 5.2 billion for 50GWh BESS through FY2032-33.

summary.title: McKinsey report finds trade barriers increase U.S. storage costs
summary.main_point: A McKinsey & Company report projects that trade fragmentation could increase capital expenditure for battery energy storage by 40% to 50%.
bullets: Cost increases are attributed to cathode material tariffs, critical mineral bottlenecks, and supply chain localization barriers.

summary.title: SIAD Group commissions PV-powered hydrogen plant in Italy
summary.main_point: SIAD Group has inaugurated a 2 MW PEM electrolyzer in Pignataro Maggiore, Italy, powered by a 2.37 MW photovoltaic field and a 1 MW battery storage system.
bullets: The project represents an investment of more than €12 million, including €8 million in funding from Italy’s National Recovery and Resilience Plan.
Renewable hydrogen produced at the facility will be compressed to pressures of up to 500 bar for industrial customers.

summary.title: Denmark adopts new grid connection prioritization model
summary.main_point: The Danish parliament has approved an emergency plan that replaces the first-come, first-served grid connection principle with a new prioritization model.
bullets: The model establishes four priority categories, with critical societal functions and new households in the highest category.
Renewable energy, carbon capture, storage, and hydrogen projects are placed in the second category, while energy storage is in the third.

summary.title: Alight acquires 2GW Swedish solar and storage pipeline
summary.main_point: Alight has purchased a portfolio of 40 utility-scale solar projects from Soltech Energy Solutions in southern Sweden.
bullets: The acquired pipeline has a total capacity of 2GW.

summary.title: Research explores railway-integrated solar potential in South Korea
summary.main_point: An international research team identified that five surface railway corridors in South Korea could host over 8.5 MW of PV capacity.
bullets: The study suggests using railway corridors to expand solar generation without competing for scarce land in densely populated areas.

summary.title: Global polysilicon prices remain stable
summary.main_point: The Global Polysilicon Marker remained unchanged at $19.312/kg, or $0.041/W, according to the OPIS Global Solar Markets Report.
bullets: Market participants face potential difficulties in fulfilling long-term delivery obligations after November.

summary.title: Battery storage adoption in U.S. residential solar grows
summary.main_point: Battery storage was paired with 37% of new U.S. residential solar systems in 2025, an increase from 25% in 2024.
bullets: In California, 74% of new residential solar installations included storage in 2025, up from 58% in 2024.
The 2025 data covers approximately 450,000 systems, representing an estimated 93% of the U.S. distributed solar market for the year.

summary.title: Clean Capital discusses middle market community solar operations
summary.main_point: Clean Capital operates as an independent power producer in the middle market, managing community solar, commercial, and industrial assets across 26 states.
bullets: The company is backed by Manulife Investment Company and has been in operation for approximately 10 years.

summary.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain completes 12.37-MW solar carport project
summary.main_point: Six Flags Magic Mountain has energized a 12.37-MW solar carport project developed with Solar Optimum.
bullets: The installation is described as the largest solar carport project in California and one of the largest single-site commercial solar carport projects in the United States.
